faqs.findQuestion: How do I find a kindergarten?
faqs.findAnswer: Open Kindergartens, search by location or program, and compare center details before choosing one.
faqs.applicationsAnswer: Parents can apply through KidsGarden. Centers and administrators review requests through private dashboards.
faqs.teachersAnswer: Public signup creates a parent account first. Teacher access requires an approved staff flow.
faqs.dataAnswer: Private dashboards are role-based, and public pages do not expose child, parent, teacher, or staff directories.
faqs.contactAnswer: Use the support email below with your account nickname, center name, and a short description of the issue.

page.contactCopy: Send us a short message and the KidsGarden support team will help you find the right next step.

Notice.welcomeTitle: Welcome to the KidsGarden Help Center
Notice.communityTitle: Share questions, family experiences, and kindergarten updates in Community

families.findSubject: How do I find a kindergarten?
families.findContent: Use the kindergarten search page to browse by location, center type, programs, age range, and capacity.
families.saveSubject: How do I save favorite kindergartens?
families.saveContent: Sign in with a parent account and use the heart icon to save kindergartens for later.
families.askSubject: Where can I ask general parent questions?
families.askContent: Use the Parent Board in the Community section to share questions and experiences with other families.

parents.applyTeacherSubject: How can I apply as a teacher?
parents.applyTeacherContent: Open a kindergarten profile and use the teacher application form if applications are available for that kindergarten.
parents.applyAdminSubject: How can I apply to manage a kindergarten?
parents.applyAdminContent: Parent accounts can submit a kindergarten admin application from My Page for Super Admin review.
parents.attendanceSubject: Can I see my child attendance?
parents.attendanceContent: Parents can view attendance for their own children after the kindergarten links the child record to the parent account.

accounts.reloginSubject: Why do I need to log in again after approval?
accounts.reloginContent: Your role is stored in your login token. After approval, signing in again gives you a fresh token with the updated role.
accounts.accountTypeSubject: What account type do I get when I sign up?
accounts.accountTypeContent: Public signup creates a parent account. Additional roles require an application or approval flow.
accounts.updateProfileSubject: Can I update my profile information?
accounts.updateProfileContent: Yes. Sign in and open My Page to update your profile details.

community.postSubject: What can I post in Community?
community.postContent: Families can share kindergarten questions, helpful updates, and parent experiences.
community.avoidContent: Avoid personal data, private child information, spam, and anything unrelated to family or kindergarten topics.
community.reportSubject: How do I report inappropriate content?
community.reportContent: Contact support through the Help Center if you notice content that should be reviewed.
